# HELICOBACTER PYLORI INFECTION

H. pylori infection is associated with peptic ulcers, gastritis, gastric

adenocarcinoma, and gastric lymphoma. Antimicrobials should be given to patients

with confirmed H. pylori infection. Antisecretory therapy should be given

concurrently.

Test of cure should be completed at least 4 weeks after completion of therapy

(recommended within 4-8 weeks after completion). Any PPI therapy must be

held for 2 weeks prior to testing.

[Click here Lab H.Pylori, stool](lrtz-h-pylori-ag-stool)

Note: American College of Gastroenterology (ACG) advises adult household

members of individuals who have a positive non-serological test for

H. pylori to seek testing trough their provider.

# First line treatment:

[Bismuth subsalicylate 524 mg PO q6h <AND> Tetracycline 500 mg q6h DI](orz-set-abx-op-bis524mgqid-tcn500mgqid-metro500mgqid-omep20mg)

<AND> metronidazole 500mg PO q6h [DI] <AND> omeprazole 20mg po q12h. Take

all for 14 days.

[NonVA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-bis524mgqid-tcn500mgqid-metro500mgqid-omep20mg)

# Alternative treatments:

Alternatives may have lower efficacy and higher resistances rates. Test of

cure extremely important.

***Consider referring patients who cannot take first line therapy to

GI pharmacist for treatment management and follow-up testing.***

[Click here Gastroenterology \(OP\) Consult - Pharmacists](gmrctz-gastroenterology-op)

# Rifabutin triple (Talicia):

Note: place medication order and PADR using order below

[Amoxicillin/Omeprazole/Rifabutin \(250/10/12.5MG\) 4 caps po tid x14days DI,H](orz-set-abx-op-rifabutin-triple-h-pylori-padr)

[NonVA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-rifabutin-triple-h-pylori-padr)

< OR >

# PCAB dual (Voquezna DualPak-Amoxicillin/Vonoprazan):

Note: place medication order and PADR using order below

[PCAB Dual \(vonoprazan 20mg q12h/amoxicillin 1000mg q8h\) po x14daysDI](orz-set-abx-op-pcab-dual-h-pylori-padr)

per package instructions

[NonVA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-pcab-dual-h-pylori-padr)

< OR >

# Clarithromycin Quadruple:

Resistance to clarithromycin is increasing. Do not use for patients with prior

exposure to macrolides. Consider susceptibility testing prior to use.

[Clarithromycin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI <AND> Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q12h R](orz-set-abx-op-clar500mgbid-amox1gmbid-metro500mgbid-omep)

<AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI] <AND> omeprazole 20 mg PO q12h. Take all

for 14 days.

[NonVA order for above](orz-set-abx-nv-clar500mgbid-amox1gmbid-metro500mgbid-omep20mg)
